content: {"reasoning":"The only denial code is CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service), the retro-auth window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and appeal/records submission have already been tried without success. Resubmission would trigger CO-18 duplicate denial. CO-197 is provider liability, so the patient cannot be balance-billed. With no viable path to payer collection and patient held harmless, the balance is uncollectible and should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
